description: User Management: the users table has no role/status columns; the controller is a stub (index only); the index view uses derived/demo data and placeholder action buttons. Add columns via migration, update the User model, build full CRUD in the controller, register a resource route, create create/edit views, and rewrite index.blade.php to use real DB columns and live action buttons. Replace the inline sidebar with the shared farm-sidebar partial. Independent of FEAT-001 and FEAT-002.
steps: 1. Run: php artisan make:migration add_role_and_status_to_users_table. In up(): $table->string('role')->default('Team Leader'); $table->string('status')->default('Active'); In down(): $table->dropColumn(['role','status']). File: database/migrations/<timestamp>_add_role_and_status_to_users_table.php.
2. Run: php artisan migrate. Verify it exits 0.

3. Edit app/Models/User.php: the model uses a PHP 8 attribute #[Fillable(['name','email','password'])]. Change to #[Fillable(['name','email','password','role','status'])]. Do not change the #[Hidden] attribute or the casts() method.

4. Edit app/Http/Controllers/UserManagementController.php: replace with full resource controller. Define $roles = ['System Administrator','Team Leader','Vocational Worker','Student/Researcher','University Management'] as a private const or local variable in each method. index(): $users = User::latest()->paginate(15); $totalUsers = User::count(); $activeUsers = User::where('status','Active')->count(); return view('user-management.index', compact('users','totalUsers','activeUsers')). create(): return view('user-management.create', ['roles' => $roles]). store(): validate name (required,string,max:255), email (required,email,max:255,unique:users), password (required,string,min:8,confirmed), role (required,in:$roles), status (required,in:['Active','Inactive']); $validated['password'] = Hash::make($validated['password']); User::create($validated); redirect to user-management.index with flash 'User created successfully.' edit(User $userManagement): note the route parameter name is 'userManagement' because Laravel converts 'user-management' resource to camelCase; return view('user-management.edit', ['user' => $userManagement, 'roles' => $roles]). update(Request $request, User $userManagement): validate name (required,string,max:255), email (required,email,unique:users,id=userManagement->id), role (required,in:$roles), status (required,in:['Active','Inactive']), password (nullable,string,min:8,confirmed); if $request->filled('password') add hashed password to update data; $userManagement->update($data); redirect with flash. destroy(User $userManagement): if ($userManagement->id === auth()->id()) redirect back with error 'Cannot delete your own account.'; else $userManagement->delete(); redirect with flash.

5. Edit routes/web.php: inside the auth middleware group, replace the standalone Route::get('/user-management',...)->name('user-management.index') with Route::resource('user-management', UserManagementController::class). Add use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash; to UserManagementController if not already imported.

6. Create resources/views/user-management/create.blade.php: wrap in <x-app-layout>. Full lg:flex layout with @include('layouts.farm-sidebar', ['active' => 'user-management']). Top header bar. Page bg-[#f4f7f3]. Card rounded-2xl. Form fields: name (text), email (email), password (password, required), password_confirmation (password, required), role (select from $roles), status (select: Active/Inactive). Input style: rounded-xl border border-[#d3e1d8] focus:border-green-600 focus:ring-green-600. Primary button bg-[#123e31] rounded-xl. Cancel link back to route('user-management.index'). Validation errors block. Flash messages.

7. Create resources/views/user-management/edit.blade.php: mirror create.blade.php. Form action route('user-management.update', $user) with @method('PUT') @csrf. Pre-fill name, email, role, status with old() + model values. Password and password_confirmation fields are optional — add helper text 'Leave blank to keep current password'. Show validation errors. Flash messages.

8. Edit resources/views/user-management/index.blade.php: a) Replace the inline
block with @include('layouts.farm-sidebar', ['active' => 'user-management']). b) Remove the @php $demoRoles / $role cycling / $isActive demo logic from the table rows. c) Replace with real columns: Display name = $user->name; Username = Str::before($user->email,'@'); Role = $user->role (real DB column); Status badge: if $user->status === 'Active' use green pill else amber pill. d) Update 'Add User' button to link to route('user-management.create'). e) Replace . g) Update stat summary at top if present to use $totalUsers and $activeUsers passed from controller. h) Make sure Str is imported in the Blade file (@php use Illuminate\Support\Str; @endphp) or use the already-available Str facade since it is auto-imported in Blade.
acceptance_criteria: php artisan migrate runs without error
Submitting the create form creates a user with hashed password and real role/status, redirects with flash
The index table shows real role and status columns (not derived demo values)
Status badge is green for Active and amber for Inactive based on real DB value
Edit icon is a real link to the edit form; submitting updates name/email/role/status
Password update is optional on edit (blank = keep current)
Delete form removes the user; attempting to delete own account shows error flash instead
verification: Fill name, email, password, confirm, role, status and submit — verify user appears in index with correct role/status badge
Click Edit on a user, change role to 'Vocational Worker', submit, verify change in index
Click Delete on a user that is not the currently logged-in user, verify removal
Attempt to delete the logged-in user's own account, verify error flash appears instead
